nodes.label: W1: Photo hydration data loss hazard
nodes.description: One unreadable/corrupt photo file voids the entire batch state on load; parseNativeBatchState returns null if any photo fails
nodes.norm_label: w1: photo hydration data loss hazard
nodes.rationale: Finding from repo audit: severity high, data loss risk

nodes.label: Syncthing transport
nodes.description: Peer-to-peer file sync using TLS, no subscription required, preserves conflict copies but does not merge, versioning is not backup

nodes.label: Recommended fix: photo hydration fail-soft
nodes.description: Per-entry fallback in hydration paths: if photo file missing/corrupt, drop just that entry's photo data instead of nulling the whole state
nodes.rationale: Recommendation A from audit: smallest change at actual trust boundary

nodes.label: Photo externalization
